notes.title: [Urgent Notice] Character Selection Screen Bug After Update
notes.content:
Hello,
This is the Maru Expedition: We can fly development team.

After the recent update, we have identified an issue where a bug occurs on the character selection screen when using the "Resume" function for some players.

At this time, this issue cannot be directly fixed on our side, and we sincerely apologize for the inconvenience this has caused.
[hr][/hr]🛠 Temporary Workaround
If you encounter this problem, please use "New Start" instead of "Resume" to play the game normally.

Additionally, for players who were playing before the update, we recommend hiring your characters before applying the update to reduce the risk of this issue occurring.
[hr][/hr]
We are working hard to identify the root cause and implement a proper fix as soon as possible.

Once again, we sincerely apologize for the inconvenience and thank all of our players for your continued support.

Maru Expedition: We can fly Development Team

notes.title: [Patch] New Character Samurai Arrives!
notes.content:
New Character
A new character Samurai has been added.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45684091/9a5f4e6b56eeb026755de0c2f3917eab1931b785.png"]
New Monsters
2 new monsters have been added. Discover them in the game.
Language Support
Added support for Brazilian Portuguese (Português-Brasil).

This localization was made possible thanks to the valuable help of Rafael Messina do Rosario.

Our sincere gratitude to him.
Balance Adjustments
Airships

Magic Power: 230 → 280

Range: +10%

Attack Range: 10 → 12

Attack Range: 10 → 12

Assassin

Attack Range: 10 → 12

Attack Range: 10 → 12

Engineer

Attack Range: 10 → 12

End of Log Collection
The log collection period has ended. No more logs will be collected.

To avoid confusion with in-game stats and to improve terminology clarity, some text descriptions have been updated.
These changes only affect text and do not impact gameplay.

Your feedback is always a great help. Enjoy your playtime!

notes.title: [Notice] Thank you for 10K registrations! New character teaser
notes.content:
Thank you for 10K registrations! It’s been an incredible week.
Hello,

We are the development team of Maru Expedition: We can fly.

Since our official release, over 10,000 players have added the game to their Steam libraries.

With a peak concurrent player count of 56 and over 900 unique players,
we’ve received far more love and interest than we ever expected.
[hr][/hr]Thank you to players in Korea and around the world
Despite its short playtime, players across the globe have shared gameplay videos and livestreams,
and many Korean streamers featured our game on their live broadcasts.
Thanks to all of you, the game has reached more people than we imagined.

We sincerely thank you.

Our development team has truly had the best week ever.
[hr][/hr]We’ll do our best to meet your expectations
To return the support and feedback you’ve given us, we’re currently working hard on the next update.

A new character is coming soon, and today we’re sharing a sneak peek at their silhouette.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45684091/09fb158049288544256bd47281e6b1d0cfe307ec.png"]

→ Feel free to leave your guesses in the comments!

Several new monster types will also be added.

We hope these small but meaningful additions bring more fun to repeated runs.

Based on player metrics, we’re also reviewing character usability and balance,
and plan to implement some adjustments in a future patch.
[hr][/hr]
We’ll continue to listen to your feedback and strive to deliver a fun and evolving gameplay experience.

Thank you once again.

— From the development team of Maru Expedition: We can fly

notes.title: [Patch] 2025.07.28 Update
notes.content:
Steam Cloud Support
Steam Cloud is now supported!

(It was intended to be supported at launch, but was disabled due to a bug)
Bug Fixes
Fixed an issue where the next stage was displayed incorrectly in some languages.

Fixed a bug related to the selection window UI.

notes.title: [Patch] 2025.07.26 Update
notes.content:
Bug Fixes
Fixed an issue where the next stage text would not display correctly after loading from a shop save.

Fixed an issue where the game would not proceed to the next stage after clearing a boss and loading from the following shop.
Language Support
French (Français) is now supported.

This localization was made possible thanks to the generous help of Aurélien Folley.
We truly appreciate the support.
Ending
The ending credits will now appear only once after clearing Difficulty 3.

Your feedback always means a lot to us. Enjoy the game!
